records.source: [NPC] Calvin: Hey, you're a familiar face!
records.speaker: Calvin

records.source: [NPC] Calvin: I don't have any Returning Player Rewards for you right now. Thanks for playing SkyBlock!
records.translation: [NPC] Calvin: Сейчас у меня нет для тебя наград за возвращение. Спасибо, что играешь в SkyBlock!
records.speaker: Calvin
records.legacy: §e[NPC] §dCalvin§f: §fI don't have any Returning Player Rewards for you right now. Thanks for playing SkyBlock!

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: I need something to pass the time while I wait to be reincarnated.
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Нужно чем-то заняться, пока я жду перерождения.
records.speaker: Ghost of Game Agent
records.legacy: §e[NPC] §6Ghost of Game Agent§f: §fI need something to pass the time while I wait to be reincarnated.

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Well hopefully I can't bore myself to death given the fact I'm already dead!
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Что ж, надеюсь, от скуки я не умру — я ведь уже мёртв!
records.speaker: Ghost of Game Agent
